papers.title_en: ActiveLang: Active Open-Vocabulary 3D Mapping with Semantic-Uncertainty-Guided Exploration
papers.authors: Liyan Chen, Hairong Yin, Huangying Zhan, Yi Xu, Raymond A. Yeh, Philippos Mordohai
papers.evidence: 机器人主动探索并联合构建开放词汇语义与几何地图
papers.tldr: 机器人常需在陌生环境中执行新任务，事先无法确定要识别的语义概念，因此仅有几何地图不足以支持灵活理解与人机交互。ActiveLang在线适配语言特征，以紧凑双高斯表示联合重建场景几何、外观和开放词汇语义，并依据语义不确定性主动选择有信息量的观测视点。Replica与ScanNet++实验表明，该方法的二维和三维开放词汇分割均显著优于在线及离线基线。结果说明主动探索可减少观测与计算开销，更高效地构建可供语言查询的三维地图。
papers.abstract_en: As robots increasingly assist humans with diverse tasks, they need both geometric and semantic understanding of their surroundings. Moreover, robots often operate in unfamiliar environments and take on new tasks without knowing the relevant concepts ahead of time. This motivates language-annotated 3D maps that support open-vocabulary scene understanding and human-robot interaction. We introduce ActiveLang, an autonomous system for active open-vocabulary 3D mapping with semantic-uncertainty-guided exploration. ActiveLang performs online language-feature adaptation on a compact dual-Gaussian representation to jointly reconstruct scene geometry, appearance, and open-vocabulary semantics with modest memory overhead. Its planner efficiently selects informative viewpoints, enabling effective mapping with fewer observations and lower computational cost. Experiments on Replica and ScanNet++ demonstrate substantial improvements in 2D and 3D open-vocabulary segmentation over both online and offline baselines, highlighting that actively exploring scenes builds language-annotated 3D maps more efficiently.

papers.title_en: Energy-Efficient Gait Adaptation via Hierarchical Reinforcement Learning for Quadrupedal Locomotion Across Diverse Terrains
papers.authors: Ammar Issa, Anubhav Singh, Anton Tsaritsin, Sergey Kolyubin
papers.evidence: 训练四足机器人跨地形调整步态并执行稳定运动
papers.tldr: 腿式机器人需要在不同速度和地形上兼顾稳定运动与低能耗，但端到端强化学习把步态生成、动作执行和能耗优化耦合，容易受奖励设计影响。本文提出分层强化学习框架，以高频策略执行稳健关节运动、低频策略显式优化运输成本，并通过 Isaac 三阶段训练实现零样本仿真到实机迁移。结果显示，机器人会随速度由低速踱步切换为高速小跑，在平地、崎岖地面和斜坡上保持鲁棒运动，并在广泛速度范围内降低运输成本；方法还成功部署于 AlienGo 实机。
papers.abstract_en: While energy efficiency is a critical objective for legged-robot locomotion control, achieving low energy consumption while maintaining robust performance across different velocity ranges and terrain conditions remains a key challenge. This is particularly true for end-to-end RL policies, where gait generation, motion execution, and energy optimization are tightly coupled, leading to high sensitivity to reward design. In this work, we propose a hierarchical reinforcement learning (HRL) framework that separates a high-frequency policy for stable and robust joint-level motion execution from low-frequency gait adaptation that explicitly minimizes the cost of transport (CoT). The three-stage Isaac-based training procedure enables zero-shot sim-to-real transfer with improved tracking accuracy, robustness, and energy efficiency. The learned hierarchy exhibits automatic speed-dependent gait adaptation, transitioning from pacing at low speeds to trotting at higher speeds. We validate the proposed approach in simulation against representative single-policy and hierarchical locomotion baselines, demonstrating reduced CoT over a broad range of commanded velocities, while maintaining robust locomotion across flat, uneven rough, and inclined terrains. We further demonstrate its practical feasibility through zero-shot deployment on a physical Unitree AlienGo quadruped.

papers.title_en: RobotWorld: Benchmarking Multimodal Agents for Robot Use Across Diverse Tasks and Embodiments
papers.authors: Zhiqin Yang, Chenxin Li, Xiaomeng Hu, Yibin Liu, Weidong Huang, Jiankai Sun, Haitao Li, Zijian Wu, Yuzhi Huang, Fanding Huang, Hanwen Sun, Jiashun Liu, Jingqi Tong, Mingxin Huang, Shaoli Hu, Shijue Huang, Tianyi Bai, Xinyuan Wang, Yunlong Lin, Zhengyang Tang, Zhexin Zhang, Zhuo Chen, Xierui Song, Juntao Dai, Boyuan Chen, Jiaming Ji, Fangneng Zhan, Mengkang Hu, Wei Xue, Yonggang Zhang, Han Hu, Tsung-Yi Ho, Yike Guo
papers.evidence: 模拟机器人平台评测具身智能体的感知与行动
papers.tldr: 通用智能体已能编写代码、调用工具并处理复杂数字任务，但这些能力能否迁移到物理交互仍不清楚。论文提出 RobotWorld 仿真基准，涵盖84项操作、移动操作、运动、驾驶与飞行任务，并设置交互预算和可执行成功判定。执行轨迹显示，智能体虽能构建图像分割、相机标定、空间估计和动力学控制流程，却常丢失物体状态、未纠正无效动作或过早判定完成。该基准揭示能力迁移的具体断点与模型差异，为训练和设计更可靠的物理世界智能体提供评测依据。
papers.abstract_en: General-purpose agents increasingly write code, use tools, and complete complex digital tasks, raising the question of how far these capabilities carry into the physical world. To investigate this, we introduce RobotWorld, a challenging simulation testbed for robot use: turning instructions and observations into physical task execution through robot interfaces. Its 84 tasks span manipulation, mobile manipulation, locomotion, driving, and aerial control, with explicit interaction budgets and executable success checks. By analysing task outcomes alongside execution traces, we identify both the capabilities that transfer and the gaps that prevent reliable completion. Furthermore, we find that current agents can construct sophisticated perception and control workflows, including image segmentation, camera calibration, spatial estimation, and dynamics-based computation. These capabilities, however, do not consistently compose into successful behaviour: agents lose task-relevant object states despite reaching commanded poses, fail to correct ineffective actions, recover too late, or mistake unfinished tasks for completion. This uneven transfer also differs across models: Astra succeeds more often on spatial and constrained-contact goals, whereas Opus 5.5 succeeds more often on continuous-balance and timed-interaction goals. By linking these outcomes to execution behaviour, RobotWorld provides both a rigorous proving ground and an empirical account of the remaining capability gaps, thereby establishing concrete targets for training and designing more reliable physical-world agents.

papers.title_en: Cross-Embodiment Robot Foundation World Models with Latent Actions
papers.authors: Huang Huang, Sriram Yenamandra, Arjun Majumdar, Elie Aljalbout, Tushar Nagarajan, Tsung-Yen Yang, Akshara Rai, Michael Rabbat, Li Fei-Fei, Jiajun Wu, Tingfan Wu, Franziska Meier
papers.evidence: 跨机器人形态学习世界模型并预测动作条件下的环境变化
papers.tldr: 机器人形态和动作空间各异，使世界模型难以迁移到训练中未见过的机器人。论文提出 LAC-WM，通过学习跨形态共享的潜在动作空间来条件化世界模型，并与依赖显式运动标签的 EAC-WM 对比。在灵巧操作和改造版 LIBERO 基准上，LAC-WM 分别最高提升 46.7% 和 11.7%；增加预训练机器人形态还能提升其下游表现。结果表明，统一动作空间有助于高效跨形态学习，为机器人基础世界模型的泛化提供了有效方向。
papers.abstract_en: The diversity of robot embodiments and action spaces makes it challenging to build robot world models that generalize across different embodiments. We introduce the Latent Action-Conditioned Robot World Model (LAC-WM), which operates within a learned unified latent action space shared across diverse embodiments. This unified action space improves the world model's performance when adapted to previously unseen robot embodiments. We compare LAC-WM with an Explicit Action-Conditioned World Model (EAC-WM), which conditions on explicit motion labels. Our results show that explicit action conditioning leads to disjoint action representations across embodiments, limiting downstream performance when adapting to new robots. We evaluate both models on dexterous manipulation tasks and a modified LIBERO benchmark. LAC-WM improves downstream performance over EAC-WM by up to 46.7% on dexterous manipulation and 11.7% on LIBERO. Crucially, the unified latent action space allows LAC-WM's downstream performance to scale positively with the number of embodiments used during pretraining. In contrast, the disjoint action space in EAC-WM leads to decreased performance as the number of pretraining embodiments increases. These results highlight the importance of a unified action space for efficient cross-embodiment learning, addressing a key challenge in robotics. Project website: https://lacwm.github.io/

papers.title_en: Towards Path-Creative Navigation: Robot Navigation through Embodied Interaction
papers.authors: Haoyu Xi, Siwei Cheng, Xiangyuan Liu, Brenda Li, Wei Zhang
papers.evidence: 机器人协调移动与环境交互以恢复通行空间
papers.tldr: 拥挤、受限环境中的道路可能被可动障碍、铰接结构或行人阻断，传统导航只在既有空闲区域规划，因而未必能到达目标。论文提出路径创造式导航，让机器人通过移动与具身交互恢复可行空间，并设计无地图框架，融合视觉、激光雷达和里程计信息。系统结合障碍几何与距离判断障碍是否可交互、是否能安全绕行，从而按需推开结构或物体、避障或请求行人协助。仿真与两项真实场景实验中，该方法较基线取得更高任务完成率，展示了导航与交互协同处理受阻路线的能力。
papers.abstract_en: Autonomous navigation in cluttered and constrained environments typically assumes a fixed environment and searches only for paths within existing free space. However, a route can be blocked by an articulated structure, a movable object, or a pedestrian, and reaching the goal may therefore require appropriate embodied interaction with the environment. This paper formulates Path-Creative Navigation (PCN), a navigation paradigm in which the robot recovers free space by coordinating locomotion and embodied interaction, and addresses one class of PCN tasks with a mapless framework. The vision-LiDAR-odometry framework integrates local observations, obstacle geometry, and robot-state estimates through a unified navigation system, providing stable semantic and geometric information for navigation and interaction. The traversability-aware decision method utilizes visual and LiDAR distance information to determine whether a blockage is actionable and whether it can be safely bypassed, enabling the robot to interact only when necessary while supporting articulated structure pushing, movable object pushing, obstacle avoidance, and pedestrian requests. We design simulation scenarios and evaluate different methods in both simulation and two real-world tasks that cannot be completed by conventional navigation alone without embodied interaction. These results demonstrate that our framework achieves higher task completion than the baseline methods by coordinating navigation and interaction in cluttered and constrained environments.

papers.title_en: LIVIN: Benchmarking Spatial and Embodied Intelligence in Digital Twins of Lived-In Homes
papers.authors: Peijun Xu, Chuansen Nie, Yiyang He, Yinuo Bai, Jingyang Liu, Kuixiang Shao, Yuyang Jiao, Kuanhao Xia, Jiayi Zhu, Zitian Yang, Yanqi Zhang, Tianye Tan, Shuwei Di, Junyi Xu, Jingyi Yu, Jiayuan Gu
papers.evidence: 基准评估住宅环境中的空间与具身智能
papers.tldr: 真实家庭中的家具与日常物品布局会影响机器人移动和交互，但现有模拟资源往往难以兼顾场景规模、现实对应性和交互可用性。LIVIN构建了涵盖30套多样化居住家庭的数字孪生，并通过人工复核的流程重建房间结构、家具和物品配置。基准评估三维检测、三维重建、导航及移动操作，结果显示现有方法仍难应对密集摆放、遮挡、有限通行空间和受限交互区域。该资源为研究从空间理解到机器人操作的家庭具身智能提供了更贴近真实生活的评测基础。
papers.abstract_en: Realistic household simulation must capture not only diverse environments but also the lived-in object arrangements and spatial constraints that shape robot motion and interaction. Existing resources often trade off scale, real-world correspondence, and interaction readiness, leaving a gap in faithful, interactive replicas of how real homes are actually arranged. To this end, we introduce LIVIN, a benchmark for spatial and embodied intelligence built on digital twins of 30 diverse lived-in homes. These replicas preserve observed room layouts, furniture configurations, and everyday belongings. To construct them, we design a human-in-the-loop workflow comprising instance recognition, architectural reconstruction, and object generation and placement, with intermediate results reviewed and corrected by humans against the source observations at each stage. We evaluate four tasks in LIVIN: 3D detection, 3D reconstruction, navigation, and loco-manipulation. Our evaluations show that current methods remain challenged by the dense object arrangements, occlusions, limited free space, and constrained interaction regions found in realistic lived-in homes. We hope LIVIN will help advance embodied AI in real-world homes, from spatial understanding to robotic interaction, and ultimately bring embodied intelligence into everyday home environments.

papers.title_en: MIRAGE: Metric Inference and Reliability-Aware Gaussian Estimation from Feed-Forward Vision
papers.authors: Xinzhe Wang, Changjian Jiang, Kaiwen Song, Xudong Li, Kerui Ren, Ran Yi, Lizhuang Ma, Chunhua Shen, Linning Xu, Tao Lu, Mulin Yu
papers.evidence: 融合前馈视觉几何与激光雷达惯性定位，联合估计位姿并进行高斯重建。
papers.tldr: 前馈视觉三维先验可支持高质量重建，却常缺乏可靠度量尺度，并在长时程运行中产生轨迹漂移；激光雷达—惯性估计能提供准确度量运动，但难满足高保真重建的图像一致性需求。MIRAGE将视觉几何锚定到激光雷达—惯性运动，并按匹配支持度和跨模态一致性调节在线位姿修正。实验显示，它在多个数据集上实现准确度量轨迹估计，优于常用视觉基准方法COLMAP。研究还建立长时程室内单目重建基准并评测近期方法，为该领域提供参考。
papers.abstract_en: Feed-forward 3D priors enable high-quality reconstruction from image streams but often lack reliable metric scale and suffer from long-term trajectory drift. In contrast, LiDAR--inertial estimation provides metrically accurate motion but lacks the image-space consistency needed for high-fidelity reconstruction. We propose $MIRAGE$, which anchors feed-forward visual geometry to LiDAR--IMU metric motion and regulates online pose corrections according to correspondence support and cross-modal agreement, jointly enabling accurate metric pose estimation and high-fidelity Gaussian reconstruction. Experiments on Oxford Spires, M2DGR and INS show that MIRAGE achieves accurate metric trajectory estimation, outperforming COLMAP, a widely used but computationally expensive reference for vision-only benchmarks. Motivated by the scarcity of long-horizon monocular benchmarks for large-scale indoor reconstruction, we further build a multimodal data-collection platform and use MIRAGE to establish accurate 6-DoF reference trajectories for a new vision-only benchmark. We benchmark recent monocular large-scale reconstruction methods on this dataset, providing a systematic evaluation of their performance in long-horizon indoor scenes.

papers.title_en: Tactile Sensing-based Secure and Gentle Grasping of Unknown Objects
papers.authors: Feng Han
papers.evidence: 通过触觉感知和预测控制实现未知物体安全抓取
papers.tldr: 未知物体的动态抓取既要避免滑移，又须防止挤压损伤，同时往往缺少物体模型与预训练数据。论文提出基于触觉的在线数据驱动预测控制，利用双单通道触觉模块实时感知交互，通过有限状态机探测初始抓力和约束，并以高斯过程在线学习动力学，将模型不确定性纳入模型预测控制。系统以100赫兹运行，在多种表面和物体上验证有效，可处理生豆腐、棉花糖及岩石，兼顾安全、温和与动态操作，为无需先验知识和离线训练的未知物体抓取提供了新方案。
papers.abstract_en: Reliable robotic manipulation requires maintaining a firm grasp while strictly avoiding both contact slip and structural damage to the object. Satisfying these inherent \textit{secure-and-gentle} grasping constraints is challenging for unknown objects. We present a novel online data-driven predictive control framework for safe dynamic robotic grasping of unknown objects. The proposed system features a pair of compact, single-channel tactile-sensing modules that characterize the gripper-object dynamic interaction in real time, entirely bypassing the need for prior knowledge or offline training. A finite-state-machine-based grasping force probing mechanism is developed to establish the initial grasping force and explicitly identify grasping force constraints. Through online dynamics learning, a Gaussian Process (GP) model captures gripper-object interaction dynamics. The model uncertainties are further used to form robust grasping constraints, which are embedded into a model predictive control scheme. We demonstrate error convergence in a probabilistic sense. The proposed control framework runs at 100~Hz in real time to dynamically manipulate and handle objects rather than static holding. Extensive experimental evaluations across diverse contact surface topologies and various types of objects validate superior performance and efficiency compared to baseline strategies. The proposed method is able to manipulate objects ranging from delicate items, such as raw tofu and marshmallows, to rough objects, such as rocks.

papers.title_en: Volume Rendering with Metric--Phase Fields for Thin Structures and Sign-Ambiguous Geometry
papers.authors: Junkai Deng, Jiayi Kong, Xuhui Chen, Guanli Hou, Fei Hou, Junhui Hou, Wenping Wang, Ying He
papers.evidence: 改进隐式表面重建，重点处理薄结构与非流形等符号不确定几何。
papers.tldr: 基于有符号距离场的神经体渲染依赖全局内外符号，在薄片、管状结构及边界或非流形几何上容易产生错误封口或丢失细节；无符号距离场虽适应性更强，却难以稳定优化。本文提出 PhaseSurf，以度量—相位场分解无符号邻近度与软符号提示，并通过残差相位注入构造兼具稳定近表面梯度和歧义区域鲁棒性的隐式函数。配合针对度量一致性、界面相位转换及自由空间伪几何的损失，可直接用 Marching Cubes 提取等值面。多视图实验显示其重建稳定性和几何质量优于无符号场方法及近期 3DGS，同时减少传统有符号场伪影。
papers.abstract_en: Neural implicit surface methods that couple volume rendering with signed distance functions (SDFs), such as VolSDF and NeuS, achieve high-quality multi-view reconstruction for watertight objects. However, these approaches rely on a globally consistent inside-outside partition of space. This assumption becomes fragile for thin structures (e.g., sheets, tubes, and thin walls) and can break down for sign-ambiguous geometry (e.g., surfaces with boundary, non-manifold junctions, and closely spaced surface components), often resulting in spurious closures or loss of fine structures. Unsigned distance field (UDF) formulations relax the global sign requirement and better support non-watertight geometry, but are substantially harder to optimize. We propose PhaseSurf, a neural volume rendering framework built on Metric-Phase Fields (MPFs). MPFs decompose geometry into a nonnegative metric field capturing unsigned proximity and a continuous phase field providing a soft sign cue. By coupling the two through residual phase injection, MPFs yield a signed composite implicit function with stable near-surface gradients while retaining UDF-like robustness in sign-ambiguous regions. This design enables direct iso-surface extraction using standard Marching Cubes and avoids the failure modes of both pure SDF- and UDF-based formulations. We further introduce MPF-specific training losses that enforce metric consistency, stabilize phase transitions near the interface, and suppress spurious geometry in free space. Experiments on multi-view datasets with thin structures and sign-ambiguous geometry show that PhaseSurf produces more stable reconstructions and higher-quality geometry than UDF-based methods and recent 3DGS pipelines, while avoiding artifacts typical of SDF-based approaches.

papers.title_en: CompactSplat: Spatially Adaptive Gaussian Distribution for Feedforward Scene Reconstruction
papers.authors: Bing He, Jingnan Gao, Yunuo Chen, Zhengxue Cheng, Rong Xie, Li Song, Wenjun Zhang
papers.evidence: 从稀疏视图前馈重建三维场景，并改进高斯表示分配
papers.tldr: 稀疏视图下无需逐场景优化的三维重建，仍难兼顾几何准确性、细节纹理与表示效率；现有前馈三维高斯方法按像素均匀分配基元，容易在平坦区域产生冗余，也难充分利用平面结构先验。CompactSplat结合纹理引导空间划分与层级采样，在复杂区域密集布点，在平坦区域使用扩展且尺度调制的高斯，并可在推理时调节稀疏度。它在RealEstate10K、DL3DV和ScanNet上优于既有方法，以更少基元获得高保真重建和更一致的高分辨率渲染。该方法无需重训即可权衡渲染质量与内存占用。
papers.abstract_en: Reconstructing 3D scenes from sparse views without per-scene optimization remains highly challenging, especially for recovering accurate geometry and fine textures. While recent feedforward approaches leverage generalizable 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) for scene generation, they typically assign one or multiple Gaussians to each pixel. Such uniform allocation not only produces highly redundant representations by wasting primitives in homogeneous areas, but also fails to exploit the inherent geometric priors of planar surfaces, often resulting in sub-optimal structural modeling. To address these limitations, we present CompactSplat, a novel feedforward framework that enables a content-aware allocation of 3D Gaussians. By integrating texture-guided spatial partitioning with hierarchical sampling, CompactSplat adaptively distributes primitives - concentrating dense Gaussians in complex regions while tiling flat areas with expanded, scale-modulated primitives. Moreover, our framework inherently supports dynamic sparsity control at inference time, enabling seamless trade-offs between rendering fidelity and memory footprint without requiring network retraining. Extensive experiments on RealEstate10K, DL3DV, and ScanNet demonstrate that CompactSplat consistently outperforms prior methods on both standard metrics and high-resolution rendering consistency, achieving high-fidelity reconstructions with significantly fewer primitives.

papers.title_en: Unravel: Recovering an Interactive 3D Scene from a Single Image
papers.authors: Hui Shan, Keyang Luo, Binjia Zhou, Ming Li, Kai Li, Xin Wang, Zhenyang Li, Zesong Yang, Weikai Chen, Runze Zhang, Xin Wang, Yanwei Fu, Zhen Chen, Xiangru Huang
papers.evidence: 从单幅图像分解场景对象并恢复可交互三维场景
papers.tldr: 从单张图像恢复可交互三维场景时，遮挡会妨碍物体重建，一次性预测也难以发现和修正错误。训练免调的Unravel先逐层移除可见物体并修复遮挡区域，每次编辑经核验后纳入重建，再按反向顺序组装独立点云资产。它将观测点视为物体尺寸下限，并通过物理沉降和智能审查修正悬浮、穿插及摆放问题。实验表明，该方法恢复物体更多、位置更准确且场景更符合物理规律，为单图生成可编辑场景提供了稳健思路。
papers.abstract_en: We present Unravel, a training-free framework that turns a single image into an interactive 3D scene, where every object is an independent and movable asset. Existing generators either produce one entangled geometry in which no object can be moved, or predict all objects in one feed-forward pass, where a wrong guess cannot be detected or repaired. Unravel instead takes a different approach: it first takes the scene apart, and then puts it back together. Starting from the input image, an agentic harness that iteratively peels the image layer by layer, and adopts point cloud as major modality for spatial relationship recovery. Specifically, a vision-language model plans which objects are fully visible, an image editor removes them and restores the occluded regions. Every edit is verified before being incorporated into the reconstruction. This process gradually turns occluded parts of the scene into direct observation, allowing objects to be reconstructed when they are best exposed rather than hallucinated from the original image alone. The scene is then rebuilt in reverse removal order, so that the supporting objects are naturally placed before the objects they support. Since a single-view image only reveals part of an object, we treat the observed points as a lower bound on its size: an asset may grow to cover its points, but can not shrink away from them. Finally, we physically settle the reconstructed scene to remove floating objects and interpenetrations, followed by an agentic audit that corrects remaining placement errors. Extensive experiments on diverse indoor scenes show that Unravel recovers more objects, places them more faithfully, and produces scenes that are more physically-plausible than existing methods.

papers.title_en: From Pixels to Executable Physics: Behavior-Grounded World Models for Embodied Action Consequence Prediction
papers.authors: Ruo Chen, Jiahua Pang, Yingjie Niu, Hongyi Lin, Jun Tian, Yang Zhu, Chao Li
papers.evidence: 利用场景几何和机器人—地形接触动力学预测动作后果
papers.tldr: 户外地形和接触条件变化会使相同动作指令产生不同运动结果，视觉上逼真的未来预测也可能高估机器人表现。论文提出DR-WM，从初始RGB图像重建场景几何，并融合由真实动作响应校准的地形接触先验，通过物理仿真生成运动轨迹与渲染结果，指导视频世界模型预测，再用生成观测更新地形模型，实现无需新增真实图像的迭代推演。实验显示，该方法在关键物理指标上优于几何基线和统一物理参数基线；在90个挑战场景中，接入DR-WM的8B视觉语言模型有五项指标胜过未增强的32B模型。结果表明，物理一致的后果预测能支持更可靠的具身动作选择。
papers.abstract_en: In outdoor environments, varying terrain and contact conditions can cause identical action commands to produce different motion outcomes for quadruped robots. Predicting these outcomes is essential for reliable navigation and informed path selection. Existing video world models can generate visually plausible futures, yet often struggle to capture robot dynamics and terrain interactions, leading to overly optimistic predictions of action outcomes. We present DR-WM, a physically consistent world model that incorporates robot-terrain contact dynamics to predict the consequences of quadruped actions. Starting from an initial RGB image, our method reconstructs scene geometry and integrates dense, dimensionless priors over terrain contact properties, calibrated using real-world action-response data. The resulting terrain model supports the simulation of physics with spatially varying contact properties such as friction. Given the initial state of the robot and candidate action sequences, we simulate its future motion and use the resulting camera trajectories and rendered geometry to guide the training of a video world model. The generated future observations are then used to update the terrain reconstruction, enabling iterative model rollouts without additional real-world images. Extensive experiments demonstrate that DR-WM substantially outperforms geometry-only baselines and baselines with uniform physical parameters on key physical metrics characterizing action outcomes, while achieving the best performance among the evaluated baselines. These physically grounded predictions support more informed action selection: across 90 challenging scenarios, an 8B vision-language model augmented with DR-WM outperforms an unassisted 32B vision-language model on five of six evaluation metrics.

papers.title_en: Physics-Aware Object-Centric SE(3) Forecasting for Real-Time Proactive Dynamic Grasping
papers.authors: Yirui Zhou, Hongli Xu, Ying Zheng, Yi Wang, Lap-Pui Chau
papers.evidence: 预测物体未来刚体状态以实现主动动态抓取
papers.tldr: 动态抓取要求机器人预判物体未来发生接触的时机与位置，单看当前位姿不足以支撑主动拦截，而预测完整未来场景又代价高昂。论文提出以接触相关的刚体状态作为任务所需抽象，从短时位姿历史预测物体在三维空间中的运动，并选择满足可达性、运动学和时序约束的拦截状态。该方法在仿真中将平均成功率从24.5%提高到62.0%，在真实抓取任务中从15.3%提高到67.3%，预测耗时仅15毫秒。结果表明，紧凑的物理未来预测即可支持实时主动抓取，为高效部署提供了实用路径。
papers.abstract_en: Proactive dynamic grasping requires robots to predict the future state at which physical contact will occur, rather than reacting to the currently observed object pose. But what future must the robot predict, and at what level of abstraction? We argue that contact-relevant rigid-body state in SE(3) is a compact task-sufficient abstraction for this problem: it directly determines where and when the robot should establish contact, without requiring visually complete future scenes. This insight leads to a lightweight object-centric forecast-then-select framework that predicts future rigid-body trajectories from short pose histories and uses a reachability-aware interception selector to choose feasible contact states under kinematic and timing constraints. Trained with randomized physics simulation over primitive shapes, the forecaster transfers to real objects once their metric geometry and SE(3) state histories are recovered. Experiments across simulation and real-world dynamic grasping tasks show that our framework improves the average success rate from \(24.5\%\) to \(62.0\%\) in simulation, and from \(15.3\%\) to \(67.3\%\) in real-world catching, conveyor, and turntable interception. The SE(3) forecaster runs in \(15\,\mathrm{ms}\), orders of magnitude faster than dense visual future prediction, enabling real-time contact decision making. Our results suggest that effective proactive grasping does not require imagining the entire future scene. Instead, predicting the compact physical future that determines contact provides an effective and practical abstraction for real-time dynamic grasping.

papers.title_en: ABot-ER: Unified Embodied Reasoning through Agentic Data-Model Co-Evolution
papers.authors: Qiuyu Ding, Heng-Da Xu, Changda Xia, Jiajun Shen, Zihao Guan, Zhengchen Yuan, Jianfang Zhang, Di Yang, Jiayi Tian, Yuting Xu, Fei Wang, Shiao Liu, Wei Zhang, Xiaolong Wu, Wenbin Tang, Zedong Chu, Mu Xu
papers.evidence: 统一具身推理模型涵盖场景感知、长程规划与执行
papers.tldr: 具身智能需要协同完成感知、规划与执行，但统一模型往往难以兼顾跨任务广度和各能力深度。ABot-ER提出智能体式数据与模型协同演进引擎，并以任务条件自适应训练在共享骨干上启用轻量低秩残差。模型覆盖空间、场景、时间推理，长程动作组织，以及点位定位与可供性等能力。在覆盖三项核心能力、五类维度的十二个基准上取得统一框架整体最优表现，显示广度与专精可以兼得。
papers.abstract_en: We introduce ABot Embodied Reasoning (ABot-ER), a unified embodied reasoning foundation model that breaks the tension between breadth and depth in embodied reasoning. Embodied intelligence demands the joint mastery of perception, planning, and execution, yet reconciling generality with specialization across this spectrum remains an open challenge. Within a single unified model, ABot-ER commands specialist-level depth across all three competencies, spanning spatial, scene, and temporal reasoning in perception; long-horizon action organization in planning; and point grounding and affordance in execution. The Agentic Data-Model Self-Evolution Engine continuously adapts data strategies to the model's evolving capability state. The Task-Conditioned Adaptive Training Strategy uses task tokens to activate lightweight low-rank residuals over a shared backbone, separating updates from heterogeneous output formats while retaining shared embodied knowledge. Across a systematic evaluation on twelve benchmarks covering three core competencies and five capability dimensions, ABot-ER achieves state-of-the-art overall performance across perception, planning, and execution within a unified parametric framework, demonstrating that breadth and depth can coexist in unified embodied reasoning.

papers.title_en: Remember, Revisit, Revise: Scaffold Memory for Long-Horizon 3D Geometry
papers.authors: Soumick Sarker, Mengmi Zhang
papers.evidence: 通过可修订记忆提升长时程三维几何与相机位姿重建
papers.tldr: 几何基础模型虽能从视频估计相机位姿与场景结构，但固定窗口推理会使跨窗口误差累积，流式模型又无法依据后续证据修正旧估计。论文提出SMORE，为冻结模型配备可修订外部记忆，关联观察位置与视觉内容，并支持存储、检索、核验和修订。在八种模型、五类数据集上，SMORE改善长序列位姿估计，深度误差最高降低58%、点云倒角距离最高降低43%，长程SLAM轨迹误差低至2.9厘米。结果表明，可修订记忆能将预训练几何模型扩展为长期迭代纠错推理，并提升大场景重建一致性。
papers.abstract_en: Geometry foundation models estimate camera poses and 3D scene structure from video sequences, but maintaining consistent reconstructions over long horizons remains challenging. Feed-forward models process long sequences as independent, fixed-length frame windows and align their predictions, causing pose and reconstruction errors to accumulate across windows. Streaming models retain information from past frames to inform future predictions, but cannot revise earlier estimates when later observations reveal errors. To address this, we introduce Scaffold MemOry for Revision (SMORE), a framework equipping frozen geometry foundation models with a revisable external memory for long-horizon inference. Inspired by hippocampal associative memory in biological brains, which links spatial context with sensory experience, SMORE associates where an observer is with what it observes, enabling past observations to be stored, retrieved, verified against new evidence, and revised when inconsistencies are detected. We evaluate SMORE with eight competitive geometry models on five datasets spanning camera pose estimation, multi-view depth estimation, 3D point-cloud reconstruction, simultaneous localization and mapping (SLAM), and novel view synthesis. Across all evaluated models, SMORE consistently improves long-sequence pose estimation, reduces multi-view depth error by up to 58%, reduces Chamfer distance for 3D point-cloud reconstruction by up to 43%, and achieves average trajectory error as low as 2.9 cm in long-horizon SLAM. By retaining corrected poses and observations, SMORE further improves the fidelity and spatial consistency of large-scale 3D scene reconstruction. These results establish revisable external memory as a flexible interface for extending pretrained geometry models beyond fixed-context prediction toward iterative, error-correcting inference over long visual sequences.

papers.title_en: MicroSDF: Microfacet-Driven Hybrid Neural SDFs for Mixed-Reflectance Surface Reconstruction
papers.authors: Lejia Ye, Yuhua Xu, Yulan Guo, Lian Xu, Xiaohu Zhang
papers.evidence: 利用神经隐式 SDF 重建混合反射表面
papers.tldr: 真实场景常同时包含镜面反射与非反射表面，两者建模需求不同，分开处理的方法难以统一兼顾重建精度与物理合理性。MicroSDF以符号距离场为基础提取宏观和微面元法线，并通过一致性约束、双分支颜色模型及反射先验引导融合进行联合建模。配合多阶段优化，该方法在DTU、Shiny Blender、Ref-NeRF和DeepVoxels上实现高保真重建并取得领先表现。其贡献在于以微面元理论连接几何与反射建模，拓展了混合反射表面的物理驱动重建方案。
papers.abstract_en: Accurate 3D reconstruction in real-world environments remains a significant challenge due to the coexistence of reflective and non-reflective surfaces, which pose distinct modeling demands. Existing methods often treat these surface types separately, limiting their generalizability and physical plausibility. To bridge this gap, we propose MicroSDF, a novel neural implicit framework that facilitates geometry and reflectance modeling through microfacet theory. Our approach incorporates three core innovations: (i) a microfacet-guided geometry model that extracts multi-scale surface normals (macroscopic and microfacet) from a signed distance field (SDF), regularized by a proposed microfacet normal consistency loss to enforce physically plausible surface orientations; (ii) an enhanced dual-branch color model, where the specular branch leverages the microfacet normals to model high-frequency reflectance, and the vanilla branch, unlike prior works, uses reflection direction (instead of viewing direction) to better model diffuse and low-frequency specular components; and (iii) a detection-guided color blending strategy that adaptively fuses the color outputs based on reflection priors, providing more physically intuitive blending than implicitly learned blending weights. Combined with a tailored multi-stage optimization scheme, the proposed MicroSDF achieves robust and high-fidelity reconstruction across reflective and non-reflective surfaces. Extensive experiments on DTU, Shiny Blender, Ref-NeRF, and DeepVoxels datasets demonstrate state-of-the-art performance, establishing a new direction for physically grounded neural reconstruction.

papers.title_en: Tactile-Guided Robot Learning: From Representation Learning to Foundation Models
papers.authors: Kiyanoush Nazari, Luchen Li, Haoshu Fang, Nima Fazeli, Zhibin Li, Fumiya Iida, Thomas George Thuruthel
papers.evidence: 综述触觉感知、操作策略学习及具身物理推理
papers.tldr: 触觉已由接触检测和反应控制信号，逐渐成为机器人稳健、灵巧操作与具身学习的重要模态；然而，既有综述偏重硬件和感知，对学习驱动的触觉操作缺少系统梳理。本文以触觉在学习与控制流程中的作用为线索，综述表征和策略学习、触觉基础模型、预测与自适应控制，以及跨对象、任务、传感器、本体和仿真到现实的泛化。综述归纳了可迁移物理表征、语义推理与接触控制融合、异构数据和硬件扩展等关键挑战，并提出发展可预测、推理和适应物理交互的触觉基础模型与世界模型。
papers.abstract_en: Tactile sensing is becoming central to robust, adaptive, and dexterous robotic manipulation. Beyond its traditional role in contact detection and reactive control, touch is increasingly used to learn transferable representations, condition manipulation policies, and support embodied physical reasoning. Yet existing surveys largely emphasize tactile hardware and perception, leaving the rapid shift toward learning-based tactile manipulation insufficiently synthesized. This paper reviews tactile-guided skill learning from a learning-centric perspective, organized by the functional role of touch across the learning and control pipeline. We examine tactile representation and policy learning, tactile foundation models, predictive and adaptive control, and generalization across objects, tasks, sensors, embodiments, and simulation-to-real transfer. Across these directions, we identify common design principles and remaining challenges in learning transferable physical representations, integrating semantic reasoning with contact-level control, and scaling tactile learning across heterogeneous data and hardware. Finally, we outline emerging directions toward tactile foundation and world models that can predict, reason about, and adapt physical interactions. Together, this review characterizes the transition of touch from a task-specific feedback signal toward a core modality for general-purpose embodied intelligence. An accompanying database of the reviewed literature and associated resources is available at https://sites.google.com/view/touch-in-robot-learning-review.

papers.title_en: InfiniSplat v2: Analyzing and Improving Feed-Forward 3DGS from Any Views
papers.authors: Yongzhen Hu, Hao Yu, Jiawei Wang, Xianming Zeng, Jianyun Xu, Xingliang Liu, Ruizhen Hu, Xiaowei Zhou, Hujun Bao, Sida Peng
papers.evidence: 针对前馈式三维高斯场景重建提出结构和训练改进
papers.tldr: 前馈式三维高斯重建可由输入图像直接生成场景，但依据预测几何学习高质量高斯属性，在大幅视角变化下仍具挑战。InfiniSplat v2冻结几何分支、解耦几何与属性预测，并在训练中用真实相机位姿对齐高斯、增加大角度目标视图监督。六个数据集实验显示，同一模型在位姿条件与无位姿设置下，平均LPIPS和DISTS均优于所评方法；条件设置较最强基线分别下降25.8%和32.9%。研究还发现，仅靠图像重建监督学习的透明度会抑制几何不一致点，为提升前馈式三维高斯的新视角渲染提供了分析与方案。
papers.abstract_en: Feed-forward Gaussian reconstruction builds 3D scenes directly from input images for novel view rendering, but learning Gaussian attributes from predicted geometry for high-quality rendering under large viewpoint changes remains challenging. We analyze limitations in Gaussian attribute learning and introduce InfiniSplat v2, which improves rendering quality through architectural and training changes. Our method decouples geometry and attribute prediction with a frozen geometry branch, aligns predicted Gaussians using ground-truth camera poses during training, and adopts large-angle target view supervision. Across six datasets, the feed-forward outputs of the same trained model achieve state-of-the-art mean LPIPS and DISTS among the evaluated methods in both pose-conditioned and pose-free settings. In the pose-conditioned setting, mean LPIPS and DISTS decrease by 25.8% and 32.9%, respectively, compared with the strongest evaluated baselines. We further find that opacity learned with only image reconstruction supervision suppresses geometrically inconsistent points. Project page: https://zju3dv.github.io/InfiniSplat2/

papers.title_en: COOL: Curiosity-Driven Object Ownership Learning for Personalized Robotic Assistance
papers.authors: Samira Huber, Ruben Hammele, Sören Pirk
papers.evidence: 机器人从环境观察中学习对象关系并维护空间记忆
papers.tldr: 日常服务机器人要理解“我的背包在哪里”等指令，必须识别人、物品、位置及归属，但归属往往缺少显式标注，需要从长期互动中推断。COOL从日常观察中自主学习人与物品的归属关系，同时维护环境的长期空间记忆。为更新记忆，机器人以好奇心驱动的数据采集策略寻找信息价值高或观测已过时的位置。离线实验、消融研究和真实环境评估显示，该方法可推断真实互动中的物品归属，并用于个性化导航与任务执行。
papers.abstract_en: Robots are increasingly expected to provide personalized services in everyday environments. To do so, they must ground natural-language commands such as "Where is my backpack?" or "Find my bottle" and execute them by reasoning about object instances, people, locations, and ownership. This is challenging because ownership is rarely labeled explicitly and must be inferred from long-term, behavioral evidence of human-object interactions. To address this, we present COOL, a novel robotic framework for autonomously learning object ownership from everyday observations and maintaining a long-term spatial memory of its environment. To keep its memory current, COOL uses an agent-based curiosity-driven data collection strategy that guides the robot toward the most promising locations to gain information and refresh stale observations. Offline experiments, ablation studies, and real-world evaluations show that COOL can infer ownership relations from real-world interactions and use this knowledge for ownership-conditioned navigation and task execution.

papers.title_en: ΔWAM: Distilling Action Tangent Fields into World Action Models
papers.authors: Ke Wu, Hanwen Huang, Bo Gu, Kaizhao Zhang, Xiangting Meng, Yupeng Zheng, Zijun Xu, Jieru Zhao, Wenchao Ding
papers.evidence: 改进世界动作模型对动作引发的未来动力学变化的建模
papers.tldr: 世界动作模型以未来预测强化机器人策略，但未来画面往往由外观和场景延续主导，动作相关监督不足。本文提出动作切向场，在残差变分自编码器空间中，用强动作条件世界模型探测动作变化与未来残差变化的局部对应，并将一阶结构蒸馏到模型的去噪监督中。该方法在LIBERO-Plus、RoboTwin和RoboTwin2.0-Plus上提升了对光照、背景、相机及布局扰动的鲁棒性，且无需大规模具身预训练。进一步将多步视频去噪蒸馏为单步推理，表明聚焦动作所能改变的未来方向，可兼顾预测信息与策略稳健性。
papers.abstract_en: World Action Models (WAM) improve robot policies by augmenting sparse action supervision with dense future prediction. However, much of the predictable future is dominated by appearance and scene persistence rather than action-dependent dynamics. We observe that several recent WAM designs, including optical flow, motion-centric representations, and latent actions, can be understood from a common perspective in which world supervision becomes more efficient as it contains a higher proportion of action-relevant variation. Based on this insight, we introduce Action Tangent Fields, which reformulate world supervision through a local Taylor expansion of how actions induce changes in future dynamics. We represent future dynamics in Residual-VAE space, where the future latent remains recoverable from the current latent and its residual, and use a strong action-conditioned world model (ACWM) to probe the local correspondence between action variations and residual-world variations. This local first-order structure is distilled into the WAM to guide its denoising supervision toward dynamics that are more tightly coupled to action, rather than merely predictable from appearance. Across LIBERO-Plus, RoboTwin, and RoboTwin2.0-Plus, our method consistently improves robustness to lighting, background, camera, layout, and other environmental perturbations. Despite using no large-scale embodied pretraining, it achieves stronger robustness under several distribution shifts than pretrained policies. We further distill multi-step VideoDiT denoising into a single step for efficient inference. Our results suggest that effective WAM supervision should remain information-rich while concentrating its predictive capacity on the directions along which actions change the future.

papers.title_en: PointVGGT: Zero-Shot Multiview RGB-D Point Cloud Registration with Visual Geometry Foundation Priors
papers.authors: Haobo Jiang, Liang Yu, Jianmin Zheng
papers.evidence: 利用视觉几何基础模型先验进行多视图点云配准与位姿对齐
papers.tldr: 多视图RGB-D点云配准需要将无序扫描对齐到度量一致的全局坐标系，但传统逐对估计再全局优化容易产生局部误差、误差传播和较高计算负担。PointVGGT提出“基础先验再精化”框架，直接借助视觉几何基础模型预测全局姿态，并以度量深度解决尺度歧义。随后通过体素空间哈希建立稠密多视图对应，使用鲁棒位姿优化联合约束对应关系与重投影误差。多类场景实验验证其零样本配准精度和效率，展示了基础模型几何先验用于免训练全局配准的潜力。
papers.abstract_en: This paper addresses multiview RGB-D point cloud registration, aiming to estimate global rigid poses for unordered RGB-D scans and align them in a metrically consistent coordinate frame. The conventional pairwise-then-global paradigm suffers from locally optimized pairwise registration, severe error propagation and high computational burden. In particular, existing methods typically treat RGB data as a mere auxiliary matching cue and overlook the holistic geometric priors (e.g., camera poses and 3D models) encoded across image sequences. This paper introduces PointVGGT, a zero-shot framework built upon a novel \emph{foundation-then-refinement} paradigm that systematically leverages visual geometry foundation models (e.g., VGGT) as the computational backbone for robust, training-free multiview RGB-D registration. In the foundation stage, we directly recover metrically consistent global poses (without any pairwise estimation) by grounding the scale-ambiguous pose predictions of the foundation model against metric depth observations. In the refinement stage, we introduce an efficient voxelized spatial hashing mechanism that exploits the globally coherent 3D reconstruction (induced by the foundation model) as a shared spatial anchor, enabling dense multiview correspondences in near-linear time. On top of this, an IRLS-based robust motion-only bundle adjustment is performed using a conjugate gradient solver to jointly minimize the correspondence and reprojection residuals for multiview pose refinement. Extensive experiments on indoor/object-centric/outdoor datasets verify the outstanding zero-shot registration accuracy and computational efficiency of our proposed method.

papers.title_en: Pose-Free Feed-Forward 3D Inpainting via Learnable Mask Attention and Support Token Refinement
papers.authors: Jingyi Pan, Dan Xu, Qiong Luo
papers.evidence: 将三维基础模型扩展到无位姿多视图场景补全
papers.tldr: 三维场景修补需在缺失区域恢复外观与几何一致性，但现有方法依赖精准相机位姿，难适用于随手采集的多视图图像。FreeInpaint将三维基础模型扩展至无位姿输入，利用可学习掩码注意力保持可靠观测的空间锚定，并以支持令牌精炼注入扩散模型生成的补全证据。实验显示，该方法在多种数据集上提升修补质量，同时无需预先计算位姿且推理快速。它把位姿估计、几何恢复与跨视图补全统一于前馈流程，降低实际应用门槛。
papers.abstract_en: 3D scene inpainting aims to recover missing or occluded regions in edited 3D scenes, while ensuring geometric and textural consistency. Existing approaches, however, typically require accurately calibrated camera poses, which restricts their applicability in casual, in-the-wild scenarios and introduces additional preprocessing overhead. To overcome this limitation, we present FreeInpaint, a novel feed-forward framework that generates complete and 3D-consistent scenes directly from unposed multi-view images with masked regions. At its core, FreeInpaint extends a 3D foundation model to propagate masked regions from a reference view to other unposed views, bridging 3D reconstruction and scene inpainting while preserving the model's native ability to recover camera poses and scene geometry. Our method addresses two key challenges in adapting feed-forward 3D foundation models to masked inputs. First, masked regions can corrupt cross-view correspondence reasoning, degrading pose estimation and geometry recovery. To address this, we introduce a Learnable Mask Attention mechanism that preserves the spatial anchoring of reliable observations while allowing masked regions to progressively absorb useful context in deeper layers. Second, under severe occlusions, a single forward pass often lacks sufficient appearance evidence for high-fidelity completion. Therefore, we propose a Support Token Refinement strategy, which injects diffusion-generated support evidence as confidence-weighted auxiliary tokens to refine under-observed regions while preserving the original spatial anchor. Extensive experiments across diverse datasets demonstrate that FreeInpaint achieves superior inpainting quality, eliminating the reliance on pre-computed camera poses while keeping a fast inference speed. The project page is https://rorisis.github.io/FreeInpaint/.

papers.title_en: Look Where You Can: Active View Selection for CAD Reconstruction under Occlusion
papers.authors: Kartik Bali, Mahish Guru, Yiderigun Borjigin, Alexandra Starostina, Christian J. Cyron, Roland Aydin
papers.evidence: 主动选择可行视角以支持受遮挡物体的三维重建
papers.tldr: CAD重建常假设物体可从任意方向观察，但真实场景中的墙面、地面与遮挡会限制可用视角，且各视角的信息量并不相同。SightCAD将场景可见性作为约束，学习选择可行视角，并与生成CadQuery代码的视觉语言模型联合训练，以执行后的几何精度作为奖励。在不同视角预算下，选视策略较表面积最大化最高提升6.4个IoU点；完整系统在DeepCAD和Fusion360上分别领先最佳基线21和17个有效mIoU点。该方法也适用于T-LESS与MP6D基准，并将无效程序率控制在1.5%以内，说明面向可见性的联合优化有助于可靠重建受遮挡物体。
papers.abstract_en: CAD reconstruction methods assume a luxury reality rarely grants: unrestricted visual access to the object, photographed from any desired angle. Real objects, however, are scene-embedded, bolted against walls, wedged into corners, resting on floors, where the scene renders much of the view sphere unreachable and the remaining views unequally informative. We introduce \textbf{SightCAD}, a framework for parametric CAD reconstruction that treats view feasibility as a first-class constraint. In this work we consider objects from standard CAD benchmarks embedded in realistic indoor scenes with physically derived visibility constraints over a discrete view sphere. A learned view selector must choose $K$ feasible views for a vision--language model (VLM) that generates executable CadQuery code, scored by geometric fidelity of the executed solid. Because reward arrives only after discrete view selection, autoregressive generation, and CAD-kernel execution, we propose a joint training paradigm in which the view selector and the CAD-generation VLM are trained together against this reward. The learned selection policy departs sharply from random, uniform, and coverage-greedy alternatives, outperforming surface-area maximization (SA-max) by up to $6.4$ Intersection-over-Union (IoU) points across budgets $K\in\{1,\dots,5\}$. The full system surpasses strong external baselines on scene-embedded, occluded multi-view renders of DeepCAD and Fusion360 objects ($+21$ and $+17$ effective-mIoU points over the best baseline, respectively), as well as on test-time domain-canonicalized real images from the industrial T-LESS benchmark and on both synthetic and real images from the MP6D industrial metal-parts benchmark, while producing the highest rate of executable programs of any method compared (invalid-code rate ${\leq}1.5\%$).

papers.title_en: Learning Which Correspondences to Trust: Confidence-Weighted Event-Camera Localization in LiDAR Maps
papers.authors: Panagiotis Kiousis, Kuangyi Chen, Jun Zhang, Friedrich Fraundorfer
papers.evidence: 融合激光雷达地图、深度视图与事件相机对应关系进行位姿定位
papers.tldr: 事件相机在预建激光雷达地图中定位，通常先由深度渲染与事件图像估计光流，再利用对应点求取位姿；但传统方法主要依赖几何一致性，难以判断哪些点真正约束位姿。CELL通过可微概率PnP端到端学习逐点置信度，并将其用于加权光流监督、测试时概率筛选和边缘匹配精修，还采用避免跨越大空洞进行虚构的深度补全表示。在M3ED与DSEC多数序列上，系统优于LEAR，平移中位误差最多降低26.9%，旋转中位误差最多降低15.8%。结果显示，显式估计对应点可信度及其位姿信息量有助于改善地图定位。
papers.abstract_en: Localizing an event camera against a pre-built LiDAR map can be cast as dense optical-flow estimation between a rendered depth view and an event image, followed by a Perspective-n-Point (PnP) solver over the induced 3D-2D correspondences. Existing pipelines rely on geometric consensus during pose estimation, but do not explicitly model the reliability or pose informativeness, i.e., how strongly a correspondence constrains the camera pose, of individual correspondences. We show that the natural way to learn it -- using the per-correspondence error to constrain the learning of confidence -- suffers from a depth-dependent bias: small pixel errors reside predominantly at large depths and do not lead to high pose informativeness. Instead, in our method (CELL), we learn a per-correspondence confidence end-to-end through the pose, using a differentiable probabilistic PnP whose log-partition term encourages weight configurations that yield a better-constrained pose distribution. The learned confidence is used in three ways: (i) it reweights the flow supervision in a decoupled training scheme that keeps pose gradients out of the flow/edge backbone; (ii) it drives a probabilistic correspondence selection at test time; and (iii) together with the network's edge-probability it weights a final edge-matching refinement. We further design a partial-completion depth representation that adds signal without hallucinating across large gaps. On M3ED and DSEC our full system improves over the LEAR baseline on the majority of the evaluated sequences: it reduces the median translation error by up to 26.9% and the median rotation error by up to 15.8%.

papers.title_en: NOFACE3D: NOise-scheduled Focused Anchoring and Controlled Enhancement for 3D Generation
papers.authors: James Rose, Jingwen Liang, Wenchao Ma, Oren Jacob, Haomiao Jiang
papers.evidence: 对生成三维网格进行细节区域重建与增强
papers.tldr: 单图生成的三维资产整体形状与外观已较可信，但细小、细长及高曲率区域常因固定分辨率空间网格而重建模糊、细节不足。NOFACE3D无需训练，选取细节关键子网格并放大、重新编码，在图像裁剪条件下通过空间变化噪声调度进行流采样，同时锚定边界潜变量。随后将精修区域融回原资产，保留周边几何与外观。基于TRELLIS.2的评测显示，该方法在PAniC-3D、TexVerse及含339个标注资产的BigDetail上均优于基线，生成更清晰几何与更细纹理，为既有生成结果提供局部增强方案。
papers.abstract_en: Recent image-to-3D models generate complete, high-quality assets from a single image, with global shape and appearance that are already convincing; what remains is the fine scale, where small, thin, elongated, or detail-rich regions are reconstructed softly and under-resolved. This gap can arise in generators with fixed-resolution spatial grids: the same spatial sampling density is used for a large, smooth, low-curvature surface and for a thin, high-curvature structure that carries most of the perceived detail. To this end, we introduce NOFACE3D, a training-free framework that refines these detail-critical regions while preserving the rest of the asset. Given a generated mesh, its input image, and a refinement box, NOFACE3D extracts the selected submesh, scales it up to fill the generator's input volume, and re-encodes it into the full-resolution latent grid. Conditioned on the image crop, it refines the region through flow-based sampling with a spatially varying noise schedule that anchors boundary latents. The refined region is then integrated back into the original asset, preserving the surrounding geometry and appearance. We implement NOFACE3D on TRELLIS.2 and its sparse voxel representation; all of it operates purely at inference time on the frozen pretrained generator. We evaluate NOFACE3D on PAniC-3D, TexVerse and BigDetail, a new benchmark of 339 assets with annotated detail-critical regions. On all three, it generates sharper geometry and finer texture detail than the baselines. Project page: https://idkcouscous.github.io/NoFACE3D/

papers.title_en: SenseWeather: Multimodal Sensing for Robust Robotic Perception under Extreme Conditions
papers.authors: Fucai Ke, Sukai Huang, Junyi Hao, Kal Backman, Naim Rastgoo, Gholamreza Haffari, Hamid Rezatofighi
papers.evidence: 研究多模态感知如何支持极端环境下的机器人视觉
papers.tldr: 雨雪、尘雾与黑暗会严重损害机器人 RGB 观测，但现有预训练感知模型仍以 RGB 为中心，难以利用机载深度和红外信息。SenseWeather 构建配准多模态基准，并提出 Fusion-to-RGB，将互补传感器信息用于恢复兼容既有模型的 RGB 图像，无需修改或重训下游模型。实验在冻结的开放词汇定位与视觉语言模型上验证了融合效果：十组检测比较的 AP50 均提升，所有配对下游比较均优于 RGB 单模态恢复器。感知收益并不总与图像保真度一致，天气加剧也未导致性能单调下降，说明任务级鲁棒性应作为独立目标。
papers.abstract_en: Robotic perception must remain reliable when extreme environmental conditions severely degrade the primary RGB observation. Although robotic platforms commonly carry complementary sensors such as depth and infrared, much of the modern perception stack remains RGB-centric, creating a mismatch between multimodal onboard sensing and pretrained downstream models. We study whether complementary sensing can be used upstream to recover a task-compatible RGB observation that preserves existing perception capabilities without modifying or retraining the downstream stack. To this end, we introduce SenseWeather, a controlled multimodal benchmark for robotic perception under severe rain, snow, dust, fog, and darkness, with registered RGB, depth, and infrared observations, clean references, and grounded high-level perception tasks. We further develop Fusion-to-RGB, with two parameter-efficient sensor-fusion realizations based on token-space fusion for a diffusion transformer and residual latent conditioning for an inpainting UNet. Across frozen open-vocabulary grounding and vision-language models, RGB+D+IR fusion improves all paired downstream comparisons over the corresponding RGB-only restorers, including AP50 gains across all ten detector comparisons. Importantly, these perception gains do not consistently follow conventional image-fidelity metrics, and increasing weather severity does not induce monotonic downstream degradation. These results show that complementary sensing can preserve reusable robotic perception under extreme conditions, while highlighting task-level perception robustness as an objective distinct from visual restoration quality.

papers.title_en: TartanMatch: Towards Universal Dense Correspondence Across Modalities
papers.authors: Hyeokjoon Kwon, Jiting Cai, Ruogu Li, Kritan Bhandari, Geethika Hemkumar, Parv Maheshwari, Yuheng Qiu, Yuchen Zhang, Sebastian Scherer, Wenshan Wang
papers.evidence: 面向机器人多传感器感知的跨模态稠密对应
papers.tldr: 机器人平台需要融合多类传感器，但现有稠密对应方法往往只支持RGB图像或少数模态组合，逐对训练难以扩展，也错失跨组合迁移机会。TartanMatch以RGB预训练对应模型为基础，通过轻量级模态适配和真实、合成数据，在一个共享网络中覆盖RGB、事件、热成像、深度与投影激光雷达的全部25种有序配对。在零样本真实场景评测中，跨模态和同模态匹配端点误差较最强基线分别降低61.9%和49.6%。联合训练还能提升平均匹配精度，尤其改善困难跨模态配对，展示了统一模型的广覆盖与准确性。
papers.abstract_en: Robotic platforms combine multi-modal sensors to operate across diverse conditions, but most dense correspondence methods are limited to RGB-RGB or a small set of modality pairs. Training a model for each modality pair scales poorly with the number of sensors and forgoes potential positive transfer across modality pairs. We introduce TartanMatch, a unified model for dense correspondence across all 25 ordered pairs among RGB, event, thermal, depth, and projected LiDAR. TartanMatch adapts an RGB-pretrained correspondence model to all modality pairs within one shared network using lightweight modality adaptation and a mixture of real and synthetic data. On zero-shot real-world benchmarks, TartanMatch reduces Endpoint Error (EPE) over the strongest baselines by 61.9% for cross-modal matching and 49.6% for same-modal matching. We further show that joint training across all modality pairs improves average matching accuracy over pair-specific training, especially on challenging cross-modal pairs. These results demonstrate that a single model achieves broad multi-modal coverage and state-of-the-art matching accuracy.

papers.title_en: DSM-Free UAV Visual Localization via Latent-Depth Variable Projection and Structure-Adaptive Coupling
papers.authors: Yibin Ye, Xichao Teng, Shuo Chen, Xiaokai Song, Yuli Sun, Qifeng Yu, Zhang Li
papers.evidence: 面向无人机视觉定位，直接处理潜在深度与相机位姿估计
papers.tldr: 无人机在GNSS拒止环境中需要绝对定位，但常见的地图匹配方法依赖准确、及时的数字表面模型，实际中难以保证。论文提出潜在深度变量投影，将视线尺度作为隐变量解析消去，把估计简化为旋转优化，并在给定旋转时闭式恢复水平位置，无需假设地面为平面。进一步提出结构自适应耦合，依据单目深度推断匹配点的场景结构，在潜在深度变量投影与平面PnP之间选择。实验显示该方法优于既有无DSM方案，组合策略增强跨场景稳健性并缩小与DSM定位的性能差距。
papers.abstract_en: Visual localization enables unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) to maintain absolute positioning in GNSS-denied environments. A common approach matches UAV images with geo-tagged orthographic maps and estimates camera pose using Perspective-n-Point (PnP) with elevations from Digital Surface Models (DSMs). However, accurate and up-to-date DSMs are often unavailable in practice. Orthographic-perspective geometry (OPG) enables DSM-free localization in scenes with varying elevations, yet existing methods typically estimate pose indirectly through intermediate matrix estimation and decomposition. To address this limitation, we propose Latent-Depth Variable Projection (LDVP), which treats the unknown scales along perspective viewing rays as latent depths. By analytically eliminating these depths and solving for the horizontal camera center in closed form given the rotation, LDVP reduces nonlinear estimation to a rotation-only problem, enabling direct recovery of metric horizontal position without assuming a planar scene. To improve localization robustness across different scene structures, we further introduce Structure-Adaptive Coupling (SAC), which uses relative scene structure inferred from monocular depth estimation to select LDVP when the matched points are not dominated by a single plane, and Planar-PnP otherwise. Our local observability analysis reveals how scene elevation variation affects the geometric constraints of OPG, providing a basis for this adaptive strategy. Extensive experiments show that LDVP consistently outperforms existing OPG-based DSM-free methods, while SAC further improves robustness across diverse scenes and substantially narrows the gap to DSM-based localization. Code will be released at https://github.com/UAV-AVL/LDVP-SAC.

papers.title_en: DisParQ: Self-Supervised Part Concepts for Interpretable Vision Foundation Models
papers.authors: Adam Pardyl, Siddhartha Gairola, Sukrut Rao, Adam Wróbel, Bartosz Zieliński, Bernt Schiele, Dawid Rymarczyk
papers.evidence: 将图像区域分配到离散部件概念，可用于语义组件分解
papers.tldr: 概念式视觉模型有助于追踪模型依据，但既有方法常受固定类别限制，或依赖语言来定义概念。DisParQ从冻结的自监督视觉骨干学习空间定位的离散部件概念，无需类别标签或语言监督，并将连续残差量化为离散属性。模型以概念和属性重构骨干表征，在七个通用及细粒度数据集上评估，ImageNet线性探测准确率达83.2%，接近DINOv2教师，概念一致性优于语言对齐模型。该方法兼顾识别性能与可解释性，并支持跨类别部件检索。
papers.abstract_en: Concept-based vision models represent images through an intermediate layer of human-inspectable concepts, so what a model relies on can be traced to those concepts. However, those models are often limited to fixed categories or depend on language to define their concepts. We introduce DisParQ (Discrete Parts with Quantized attributes), a method that learns spatially grounded, discrete concept representations from a powerful frozen vision-only self-supervised backbone. It requires no class labels and no language supervision. Each image patch is assigned to exactly one concept from a learnable prototype dictionary, and only a sparse subset of concepts may activate per image. To capture how each concept varies across images (e.g., the type of a "wheel"), we learn continuous residuals alongside the concepts and then quantize them into discrete attributes. A spatial decoder reconstructs the backbone's representation from the concepts and attributes alone, so successful reconstruction means that the discrete representation preserves the backbone's information. We evaluate DisParQ across seven datasets, from general recognition (ImageNet, PartImageNet, Places) to fine-grained benchmarks (CUB, Cars, Dogs, Flowers). We show that DisParQ closely matches its frozen DINOv2 teacher on ImageNet linear probing (83.2% top-1), achieves higher concept consistency than language-aligned models, remains competitive on fine-grained recognition, and enables cross-category part-based retrieval.

papers.title_en: MATE4D: Matrix-Guided Editable 4D Generation from a Single Image
papers.authors: Xiaotian Chen, Dongfu Yin
papers.evidence: 从单张图像生成动态三维场景表示
papers.tldr: 从单张图像生成动态四维场景时，视角信息有限且运动证据不足，容易造成几何失真、时间闪烁和背景不一致。MATE4D构建时空多视图图像矩阵，以文本引导背景编辑，提供视角、外观与运动的连贯监督；再优化三维高斯基元，并通过轻量变形模块生成动画。实验表明，该方法在Objaverse-XL和Diffusion4D上优于强基线，兼顾视觉质量、效率与可控性。它提升了场景几何和时序表现，为增强现实、虚拟现实内容创作提供实用方案。
papers.abstract_en: Generative models have rapidly pushed content creation be-yond 2D imagery toward dynamic 3D and 4D scene synthesis. Yet pro-ducing realistic and temporally stable 4D content from a single image is still difficult because one view provides limited structural cues and weak motion evidence. We introduce MATE4D, a framework that converts one input image into editable dynamic 4D content. Our method constructs a spatio-temporal multi-view image matrix with text-guided background manipulation, delivering coherent supervision over viewpoint, appear-ance, and motion. These synthesized observations are used to optimize 3D Gaussian primitives, which are then animated through a lightweight deformation module to form a 4D representation. The resulting scenes preserve geometry more faithfully, maintain smoother temporal behavior, and keep background edits more consistent, reducing context ambiguity and motion artifacts. Experiments on Objaverse-XL and Diffusion4D show that MATE4D outperforms strong baselines in visual quality, effi-ciency, and controllability, supporting practical AR/VR content creation.

papers.title_en: Fresco++: Frequency-Guided and Canonical-Consistent Optimization for Fine-Grained Head Avatar Modeling
papers.authors: Shikun Zhang, Yong Li, Yiqun Wang, Qiuhong Ke, Cunjian Chen
papers.evidence: 针对多视角头部头像进行细节重建与视角一致优化
papers.tldr: 头部数字人重建常由逐视角图像监督驱动，容易过早拟合不稳定的高频细节，并造成视角间局部外观不一致。Fresco++采用频率渐进课程，先稳定低频结构，再引入高频约束；同时通过规范空间分组共识关联不同视角中的同一表面区域。方法筛除几何或可见性不可靠的观测，并在特征空间聚合其余证据，形成当前渲染的监督目标。NeRSemble实验显示其提升重建质量与跨视角一致性，多种表示上的评估也验证了方法的通用性，为兼顾细节恢复与优化稳定性提供了统一框架。
papers.abstract_en: We propose Fresco++, a unified optimization framework for fine-grained and view-consistent head avatar reconstruction. Head avatar optimization is typically driven by per-view image supervision, which can lead to premature fitting of unstable high-frequency details and inconsistent local appearance across viewpoints. Fresco++ addresses these challenges by regulating both the progression of visual detail and the formation of cross-view supervision during optimization. For frequency-aware optimization, a progressive curriculum first stabilizes low-frequency structures and then introduces high-frequency constraints to recover fine facial and hair details without amplifying spurious responses at early stages. For cross-view optimization, we introduce Canonical Group Consensus, which associates local observations through shared canonical surface regions and establishes correspondence across different viewpoints. Geometric and visibility-aware screening removes unreliable observations, while the remaining multi-view evidence is aggregated in feature space to form a consensus target for supervising the current rendering. This design enforces local consistency without relying on a specific image-space parameterization and avoids additional rendering of the auxiliary view. Together, the frequency curriculum and canonical consensus provide stable optimization from coarse structures to fine details while maintaining coherent appearance across viewpoints. Extensive experiments on NeRSemble demonstrate improved reconstruction quality and cross-view consistency, while evaluations across diverse avatar representations further confirm the generality and transferability of Fresco++.

papers.title_en: Distilling Routed 3D Privilege for Spatial Reasoning in Vision-Language Models
papers.authors: Hongxing Li, Yixin Li, Dingming Li, Zixuan Wang, Yuchen Yan, Wenqi Zhang, Weiming Lu, Yongliang Shen
papers.evidence: 将深度、语义和鸟瞰几何线索用于视觉语言模型空间推理训练
papers.tldr: 视觉语言模型从RGB图像中难以直接获得几何证据，空间推理常因深度或方向判断失误而受限，单靠最终答案奖励也难以纠正感知过程。GPD利用三维扫描训练语料中的几何信息，将深度、语义和鸟瞰图线索按问题路由给教师，并对错误轨迹施加特权蒸馏，结合GRPO训练。训练完成后模型仍只需RGB输入，无须增加部署架构或推理负担。4B模型在VSI-Bench得57.1分，四项基准平均37.6分，优于GRPO和答案特权蒸馏，显示几何特权能有效提升空间推理。
papers.abstract_en: Spatial reasoning remains a persistent weakness of vision-language models (VLMs), because RGB inputs do not directly provide geometric evidence. Existing remedies either inject 3D into the model at inference, paying architecture and latency costs, or train with outcome rewards that supervise only the final answer. Spatial errors originate in perception: a misjudged depth or direction can be corrected only by the scene's true geometry, which the 3D-scanned sources of spatial training corpora already provide. We propose GPD (Geometry-Privileged Distillation), which makes geometric evidence the privilege in on-policy self-distillation (OPSD). For each question, depth, semantic, and bird's-eye-view (BEV) cues are rendered as compact text and routed to the teacher alongside the reference answer; a privileged KL, applied only to incorrect trajectories, augments GRPO, and the deployed model remains RGB-only. On the 4B backbone, GPD achieves 57.1 on VSI-Bench and 37.6 average across MindCube, SPARBench, MMSI-Bench, and ViewSpatial, outperforming both GRPO and answer-privileged OPSD across spatial reasoning benchmarks. Ablations confirm the complementarity of 3D and answer privilege, the advantage of question-conditioned routing over full-context injection, and the benefit of restricting distillation to incorrect trajectories.

papers.title_en: MeshBind: Point-to-Mesh Binding for Non-Rigid Scene Flow Automatic Annotation
papers.authors: Yinqi Chen, E Li, Shuaijun Wang, Weiyuan Peng, Meiying Zhang, Qi Hao
papers.evidence: 多视角重建网格并绑定点云以生成运动标注
papers.tldr: 非刚性行人等物体的逐点场景流真值难以获得，限制了自动驾驶和机器人模型的训练与评测。MeshBind从六个环视相机重建关节网格并对齐激光雷达，以三角面局部坐标将点绑定到网格，结合自车运动补偿和包围框绑定生成全场景流。论文还发布覆盖4.1万帧的SFB基准，支持刚性、半刚性与非刚性分级评测。实验显示，在SFB上微调可使三类端点误差降低约2至3倍，并使非刚性误差接近刚性误差，为非刚性场景流研究提供了可扩展的标注与评测资源。
papers.abstract_en: Scene flow estimation is essential for many autonomous driving (AD) and robotic applications, but obtaining ground-truth scene flow for non-rigid objects such as pedestrians is highly difficult. We present MeshBind, an automatic annotation method that uses mesh models to generate per-point scene flow for non-rigid objects. The novelty of this work is threefold: 1) developing a multi-view module that reconstructs an articulated mesh model from six surround cameras and registers it to the LiDAR frame; 2) developing a local-frame binding technique that attaches each point to the mesh via a per-triangle tangent-normal frame, invariant under rigid motion yet adaptive to articulated deformation; 3) developing a three-layer flow registration pipeline that combines ego-vehicle motion compensation, box binding, and mesh binding to produce full-scene per-point flow. We implement MeshBind in SF-Studio, an interactive annotation tool that visualises flow and allows human mesh corrections with automatic recomputation. We also release SFB (SUScape-Flow Benchmark), a large-scale benchmark built on the public SUScape dataset, covering 41k frames with per-point non-rigid pedestrian annotations and a Rigid/Semi-Rigid/Non-Rigid evaluation protocol. Experiments show that fine-tuning on SFB reduces three-way endpoint error (EPE) by 2-3x, and brings non-rigid EPE to the same level as rigid EPE.
